Less is more! 🧹 I'm proud to share that I've led a major policy simplification initiative that has streamlined our entire compliance framework!

Over the years, like many fast-growing fintechs, we accumulated a large number of policies, procedures and guidance documents — many overlapping, some outdated, and a few that nobody could remember approving. In today's complex regulatory landscape, this created confusion and risk.

I launched a comprehensive review of every document in our compliance library. My team assessed each one against three questions: Is it still required? Does another document already cover it? Would a new joiner understand it?

The outcome has been remarkable. We retired 23 documents entirely, merged another 17 into existing policies, and rewrote the rest in plain language. Our library has shrunk from 96 documents to 41, and staff now find the guidance they need in a fraction of the time. This holistic approach has created a far more robust framework!

Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication. Every policy should earn its place!
